turns.query: How many distinct 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION' sensitive areas have their polygon centroid within 5000 metres of at least one roadside air-quality station (station_id 14, 16, or 17)? The three stations are close together and their catchments overlap heavily; count each institution only once. Return the count.
code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

query = text("""
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.id)::int AS count
FROM sensitive_area sa
JOIN air_quality_station aqs
  ON aqs.id IN (14, 16, 17)
 AND ST_DWithin(ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography, aqs.coordinate, 5000)
WHERE sa.category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
""")
schools_roadside_5km = int(pd.read_sql(query, engine)["count"].iloc[0])
print(f"Distinct educational institutions within 5000 m of at least one specified roadside station: {schools_roadside_5km}")
